# FiveBeat's film-cursor oracle counts a dot removed mid-sample as unpainted

## Context

My advisory gate-2 pre-run on dev `f034df3359` (#20022, comment 6367888840) was 235 passed, 1 failed. The red was `WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs` "showcase beat — one drag crosses two live dropzones; cancel and commit stay deterministic" at *"the app stylesheet must present every cursor as a 16px input-transparent dot"*. The arm passes alone (3/3). It reproduces with every page of the context CPU-throttled through CDP (an uncommitted probe): 2/8 red at 4×, 4/10 red at 6×.

## The Problem

`captureFilmCursorLifecycle`'s `sample()` reads each page's `.film-cursor` nodes through `locator.evaluateAll`. It counts them and judges each one's rect and computed style. The probe recorded every "unpainted" node in the failing samples, and each one was **detached**:
- `isConnected: false`, `parentNode: null`, not in `document.body`;
- an empty computed style and a 0×0 rect;
- yet still carrying `film-cursor workstation-film-cursor` and its inline `left: 1102.67px; top: 153px`.

The gesture's terminal retires the dot (`GestureDriver#retireFilmCursorDot`). Under load, that removal lands between Playwright's element query and the mapping callback. The oracle then counts a removed dot as a dot on screen without paint. The product's lifecycle is correct: the same evidence shows `finalTotal: 0` and `overlapSamples: 0`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs` (~708–727), `sample()`: `candidate.locator('.film-cursor').evaluateAll(nodes => nodes.map(…))`, then `count = cursors.length` and `unpainted = cursors.filter(painted => !painted).length`.
- `apps/workstation/tour/GestureDriver.mjs` `createFilmCursorDot` sets only inline `left/top`. Size, `position: fixed` and `pointer-events: none` come from `.workstation-film-cursor` in `resources/scss/src/apps/workstation/Workspace.scss`.
- Removal is already asserted on its own (`finalTotal`, `overlapSamples`, `maxTotal`).

## The Fix

Spec-only: `sample()` judges paint only on connected nodes. A detached dot maps to `null`: it still counts as seen, so `sourceSeen`, `maxTotal` and `overlapSamples` keep their meaning, but its paint is not judged. An attached dot without paint still fails.

*Refined during implementation:* dropping detached nodes from the count, as first written here, turned a dot sighted only at its removal into "never seen". Under 6× throttle that failed 2 of 10 runs at "film mode must expose the source cursor during the gesture".

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 (red-first): with every page CPU-throttled 6× (probe, not committed), the showcase beat is red on dev at least once in 10, with a detached node in the evidence; at head it is green 10/10.
- [ ] AC-2 (the check still bites): a planted, attached `.film-cursor` without the stylesheet's paint (probe) is still counted unpainted at head.
- [ ] AC-3 (post-merge): covered by gate 2's three full runs on the final head.

## Out of Scope

- The production cursor lifecycle (the removal at the terminal is the intended behaviour).
- The `Target worker 'cw-win-a' does not exist` lines the pre-run logged; they were not on this red's path.
